programs.desc: Venice is a city unlike any other, so it's no surprise its cemetery is also unique. Located halfway between the city of Venice and the glassblowing island of Murano, Venetians find their final resting place on the cemetery island of San Michele.

programs.title: ENTR
programs.desc: Gen Z is more fitness-crazy than ever before. We meet Mirtel, 17 years old, in Tallinn, Estonia - she has ONE goal: to win gold at the European Bodybuilding Championships. We accompany them through the toughest phase of preparation and go to the championship in Spain. What does it cost to give EVERYTHING for this - and will it be enough in the end?

programs.title: In Good Shape
programs.desc: A bad back often has no clear physical cause — but what often helps is movement. In Good Shape looks at what actually matters in back training and which workouts make a real difference.

programs.title: To the Point
programs.desc: A faltering economy, high social spending, and mounting debt: how dangerous is this toxic mix for Europe's three major industrial nations? Is the gloss wearing off? Our guests: Sophie Pornschlegel, political analyst, Katja Hoyer, Historian, Kings College, Erik Fossing Nielsen, danish economist.
